items.title: Jimmy Cobb — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Schroeder’s after I left and went through all this stuff with Miles.

ctx.x: Just to throw something out, you said the end it was – you mentioned Drinkert. But that’s – I think you talked about him earlier with Billie Holiday. So was it Drinkert, then Schroeder, or?
No, Drinkert was first. Drinkert’s when I was still in Washington. Schroeder’s after I left and went through all this stuff with Miles.
